historical_references.reference: Historical records show that Al-Idrisi mentions Kattam as a town in the Maghreb during the 12th century. The name Kattam carried significant weight in that era.
historical_references.context: Al-Idrisi was a Muslim geographer from Seville, Spain. In his famous work 'The Book of Roger', he describes Kattam as a town located in the region of Al-Masmuda in present-day Morocco, and notes its agricultural productivity and importance as a trading center for grains and other goods.
